summary: This note describes Redcap, a British television series that starred John Thaw as Sergeant John Mann, a member of the Special Investigation Branch of the Royal Military Police. It ran for two series and 26 episodes between 1964 and 1966. The note also lists supporting actors and the creator and writers behind the show.
one_line: Redcap was a 1964–1966 British TV series starring John Thaw as a Royal Military Police investigator.
key_facts: Redcap was a television series that starred John Thaw as Sergeant John Mann.
Sergeant John Mann was a member of the Special Investigation Branch of the Royal Military Police.
Redcap ran for two series and 26 episodes.
Other actors appearing in Redcap included Kenneth Colley, Keith Barron, Windsor Davies, David Battley and Allan Cuthbertson.
Redcap was created by Jack Bell.
Redcap employed a variety of writers including Roger Marshall, Troy Kennedy-Martin, Jeremy Paul, Robert Holles and Richard Harris.
